entities.title: Tests
entities.summary: The node:test suites for the rules, the reign's flow, input, the generator, pacing, layout, the display, the high-score code, the sign-in, the clean-room guard, and the bots.
entities.purpose: Checks the game without a browser: build.mjs --test bundles each *.test.ts into dist-test/, and npm test runs them after the typecheck. helpers.ts drives a reign headless with scripted keys and records a snapshot at every screen; samples.ts lists the worst-case screens the layout tests and the contact sheet share; original-hashes.json holds the guard test's truncated hashes of the original's strings, and no text.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in the verification files of the folders it checks.
Parity with the baseline runs outside this repository; it is not a test here.
